description: Details for one paper looked up by DOI only, including the abstract and a free to read link when one exists. An OpenAlex id or a malformed DOI returns an invalid ref error that points at get_paper. Inputs: doi (required, a DOI like 10.1038/nature14539 or a doi.org link). Example prompt: 'get the paper with DOI 10.1038/nature14539.'

doi.description: A DOI like 10.1038/nature14539, or a doi.org link. No OpenAlex ids here.

name: get_paper_by_doi
title: Get a paper by DOI
